svg.title: To remove the Fourier weights, use the same vj: their squared weights equal one on an exhausting sequence of momentum balls. Equality on each ball and countable exhaustion prove equality of the measures. This proves (TR24), since P 0 = P i |ki| ≤nRj on Bn,j. The harmless n + 1 in that bound also covers the vacuum sector. We record explicitly the algebraic and measure-theoretic part of the local sector estimate. Treat amplitudes as measurable functions modulo almost-everywhere equality. For a slot i, let
